note: Yearly values per zone from the area-weighted zone series (amazon_monthly.json and amazon_annual.json). Monthly variables: mean of the 12 months (sum for rainfall; burned area is the zone total in km²), only complete years (value null otherwise). monthlyRange gives, per complete year, the lowest and highest monthly value and the month (1-12) they occur in, to show the seasonal cycle that the yearly test removes. zoneTrend is Mann-Kendall + Sen's slope on the yearly zone values over the tested years, with no correction for multiple tests (only 3 zones). cellSummary counts the 1° cells of the zone (a cell belongs to a country zone when most of its in-Amazon area is in that country) from the cell tests. Hansen tree cover is shown but not tested (it cannot rise by construction); MODIS 2025 is flagged (complete: false) and excluded.
aiDisclosure: Generated by the SIGNO pipeline (pipeline/), code written with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code following the team's choices; values come only from the cited NASA and Hansen/UMD datasets.
